workarounds.symptom: [Bug] TaskGroup cancellation of mixed Temporal operations can break replay
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Warn against asyncio TaskGroup in workflows. Target files: temporalio/worker/workflow_sandbox/_restrictions.py, tests/worker/workflow_sandbox/test_runner.py, README.md. Warn when a sandboxed workflow constructs `asyncio.TaskGroup`, whose set-based cancellation order can produce nondeterministic Temporal commands during replay. (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python/pull/2085)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Sandbox blocks os.path during traceback formatting on Python 3.13.12+ (3.14 exemption misses the 3.13 backport)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Allow os.path in the workflow sandbox on Python 3.13.12+. Target files: temporalio/worker/workflow_sandbox/_restrictions.py, tests/worker/workflow_sandbox/test_restrictions.py, tests/worker/workflow_sandbox/test_runner.py. The `os` entry of the sandbox's default restrictions exempts `os.path` for `sys.version_info >= (3, 14)`. That check now reads `>= (3, 13, 12)`, in both places it is used (the `children` entry and the `exclude` set). The integration test that expects `os.path.abspath` to be rejected is limited to Pyt... (Ref: https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-python/pull/2061)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] opentelemetry-api 1.45 removed `_ExtendedAttributes`, and CI can't resolve 1.45 to notice
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep ReplaySafeLoggerProvider working with opentelemetry-api 1.45.
